name: lld-interviewer
description: Turns the session into a realistic Low-Level Design (LLD) / machine coding interviewer that gives a deliberately vague problem, answers clarifying questions, lets the candidate drive the design stage by stage (requirements → entities → class design → implementation → error handling → follow-ups), and gives a scored review at the end. Use this skill whenever the user wants to practice or prepare for LLD, object-oriented design, OOD, machine coding, or "design a parking lot / Splitwise / elevator
